# Verification

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/verification-trace.mjs`; do not edit. CI fails when it is out of date. -->

Pure rules of the Tree are proved with [LemmaScript](https://github.com/midspiral/LemmaScript) (ADR 0009):
the `//@` lines in the TypeScript are the specification, and `lsc check` has Dafny prove that the code meets it.
Each proved function names the OpenSpec requirement it proves with `//@ contract <capability>: <Requirement>`;
this page lists them, and everything the proofs assume instead of prove.

Run the proofs with `pnpm --filter @rodokmen/shared verify` (needs Dafny 4.11 on the PATH), and regenerate
this page with `node scripts/verification-trace.mjs`.

## Assumed, not proved

A verified function's `requires` are proved wherever a verified function calls it. Where unverified code
(the "shell": parsing, I/O, the clock) calls it, they are assumed; the tests cover those callers.

- `dayDate` (shared/src/edtf.ts):
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (`parseSimple`): `isValidDay(day)`
- `monthDate` (shared/src/edtf.ts):
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (`parseSimple`): `1 <= month && month <= 12`
- `rangeOf` (shared/src/edtf.ts):
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (`parseEdtf`): `spread.year >= 0 && spread.month >= 0 && spread.day >= 0`; `s.kind === 'single' ==> isValidDay(s.date.first) && isValidDay(s.date.last) && s.date.first.year >= 1 && s.date.last.year >= 1 && dayNumber(s.date.first) <= dayNumber(s.date.last)`; `s.kind === 'between' ==> isValidDay(s.start.first) && isValidDay(s.end.last)`; `s.kind === 'before' ==> isValidDay(s.end.last)`; `s.kind === 'after' ==> isValidDay(s.start.first)`
- `isLivingOn` (shared/src/living.ts):
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (`isLiving`): `1 <= today.month && today.month <= 12 && 1 <= today.day && today.day <= 31`; `forall(i: nat, i < birthLatest.length ==> 1 <= birthLatest[i].month && birthLatest[i].month <= 12 && 1 <= birthLatest[i].day && birthLatest[i].day <= 31)`
- `detectConflict` (shared/src/rules.ts):
  - uses `valueOf`, an extern (see below)
- `fixedWindow` (shared/src/rules.ts):
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (server/src/auth/limits.ts): `limit > 0`
- `valueOf` (shared/src/rules.ts):
  - an extern (`//@ extern`, or a call into another file): it has no contract, so the proofs assume only that it is a deterministic function
- `daysInMonth` (shared/src/edtf.ts), supporting:
  - its requires, where unverified code calls it (server/src/fixture/generate.ts): `1 <= month && month <= 12`

## Trusted base

Every proof above also trusts:

- LemmaScript's translation of TypeScript to Dafny (`lemmascript` as pinned in the package; a tech preview).
  Read the generated `.dfy.gen` when writing a proof, and avoid the known issues below.
- Dafny and its Z3 solver (the version pinned in `.github/workflows/verify.yml`).
- The model: `number` is a mathematical integer (no floating point, no overflow), strings are sequences of
  Unicode scalars, and the proofs say nothing about code outside the `//@ verify` functions.

## Known LemmaScript issues

Found with lemmascript 0.6.5. Keep verified code clear of these shapes, and check the `.dfy.gen` when unsure.

- **Unsound: swapped comparison.** When a narrowed optional is the right operand of `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=`, the
  Dafny puts it on the left. In code: `best === null || x < best` becomes `best < x`. In a spec:
  `xs[i] !== null ==> k <= xs[i]` becomes `xs[i] <= k`, so a false property can verify. Keep optionals out of
  verified comparisons, or write the optional on the left (`best > x`).
- **Cross-file contracts lose their helpers.** A call into another file becomes an axiom carrying the callee's
  contract, but functions that contract mentions (from the callee's own file, or named only in `//@` lines)
  are not emitted, and Dafny reports an unresolved identifier. Keep a verified call graph in one file, or
  give cross-file callees contracts that mention only their parameters.
- **Constant objects.** `as const` objects are not emitted, and `Record<Union, number>` constants get string keys
  (a Dafny type error). Pass such constants in as parameters.
- **Disjunctive narrowing in specs.** `a === null || a.f === null ==> P` does not narrow `a`; write
  `a === null ==> P` and `a !== null && a.f === null ==> P`.
- **Calls in `?:` branches** are lifted out and run unconditionally in the model. That is harmless for pure,
  total functions (at worst a proof fails), but their `requires` must hold on both branches.
- **Regular expressions** cannot be extracted: put `//@ skip` before a regex constant.
- **`lsc regen`** does not batch: give it the file (`pnpm --filter @rodokmen/shared verify:regen src/x.ts`).
- **`unknown`** becomes an opaque type without `null`: a function that returns `null` as an `unknown` cannot be
  translated. Mark it `//@ extern` (as `valueOf` in rules.ts), so the proofs treat it as an unknown function.
- **Narrowing after an early `=== null` return** makes a later `!== null` test of the same variable a Dafny type error.
- **`splice`** is not supported: write `[...a.slice(0, i), x, ...a.slice(i)]`.
- **Existential goals (Dafny).** Dafny proves "there is a …" only when a witness is already a term in the proof, and it
  rarely finds one inside a loop invariant. Name such a property with a `.some(...)` predicate (`isBlocking`,
  `hasProposal` in rules.ts), so that it is proved from the element at hand, and give `.dfy` hints (`var x :| …`)
  when a proof chains several.

Checked for the swapped comparison: in every `//@ verify` function of shared/src/edtf.ts, shared/src/living.ts and
shared/src/rules.ts, no narrowed optional is an operand of `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=`, in code or in a specification
(optionals occur only in `===` and `!==`, where order does not matter), and the generated `.dfy.gen` was read for it.
Recheck this, and read the `.dfy.gen`, whenever a proof is added or changed.
